```{=html}
<style>
  body:has(.alt-home-desktop) #quarto-header,
  body:has(.alt-home-desktop) #quarto-footer,
  body:has(.alt-home-desktop) .nav-footer,
  body:has(.alt-home-desktop) #title-block-header { display: none !important; }
  body:has(.alt-home-desktop) { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }

  .alt-home-desktop { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #609391 0%, #4f817e 55%, #3d6d6b 100%); color: #251928; height: 100vh; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; position: fixed; width: 100vw; z-index: 9999; }
  .alt-home-desktop::before { background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,.055) 0, rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px, rgba(21,61,60,.07) 2px, rgba(21,61,60,.07) 3px); content: ""; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; position: absolute; }
  .alt-home-desktop::after { background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.10), transparent 26%, transparent 72%, rgba(18,50,51,.17)); content: ""; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; position: absolute; }
  .alt-home-desktop, .alt-home-desktop * { cursor: none !important; }
  .alt-computer-intro { align-items: center; background: #568984; display: grid; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; position: absolute; z-index: 6; }
  .alt-computer-visual { left: 50%; max-width: none; position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -32.2%); transform-origin: 50.5% 32.2%; width: min(1100px, 94vw); }
  .alt-computer-visual > img { display: block; width: 100%; }
  .alt-computer-preview { height: 42.55%; left: 25.1%; overflow: hidden; position: absolute; top: 11.05%; width: 50.9%; }
  .alt-computer-preview img { display: block; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; width: 100%; }
  .alt-home-desktop.is-zooming .alt-computer-visual { animation: alt-zoom-into-screen 3.6s cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1) both; }
  .alt-home-desktop.is-ready .alt-computer-intro { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .28s ease-out; }
  .alt-desktop-icons, .alt-layer { inset: 0; position: absolute; }
  .alt-desktop-icons { align-content: start; display: grid; gap: 18px 28px; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, clamp(58px, 7vw, 92px)); grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 78px); inset: auto; left: 3vw; position: absolute; top: 4vh; z-index: 1; }
  .alt-icon { align-items: center; color: #311c32; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: monospace; font-size: clamp(7px, .75vw, 11px); font-weight: 900; gap: 3px; left: 3vw; line-height: 1.05; position: absolute; text-align: center; text-decoration: none !important; width: clamp(58px, 7vw, 92px); }
  .alt-icon img { image-rendering: pixelated; max-height: 48px; max-width: 56px; object-fit: contain; }
  .alt-icon span { text-decoration: none !important; }
  .alt-icon:hover img, .alt-icon:focus-visible img { animation: alt-bounce .42s steps(3, end) both; }
  .alt-icon { left: auto !important; position: relative; top: auto !important; }
  .alt-contact img { max-width: 72px; }
  .alt-taskbar { align-items: center; background: #d6d2ca; border-top: 3px solid #f8f8f0; bottom: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 2px #fff; display: flex; font-family: monospace; font-size: clamp(10px, 1.1vw, 15px); font-weight: 900; height: 38px; left: 0; padding: 0 8px; position: absolute; right: 0; z-index: 4; }
  .alt-start { background: #d8b8df; border: 2px outset #fff; margin-right: 10px; padding: 4px 10px; }
  .alt-task-label { border: 2px inset #fff; padding: 4px 10px; }
  .alt-message, .alt-welcome, .alt-loading { align-items: center; display: grid; justify-items: center; z-index: 3; }
  .alt-message img, .alt-welcome img { height: min(68vh, 700px); object-fit: contain; width: min(72vw, 700px); }
  .alt-hotspot { background: transparent; border: 0; height: 12%; left: 37%; position: absolute; top: 65%; width: 28%; }
  .alt-welcome .alt-continue { background: transparent; border: 0; height: 11%; left: 35%; padding: 0; position: absolute; top: 63%; width: 28%; }
  .alt-loading img { height: min(42vh, 420px); max-width: 58vw; object-fit: contain; transform: scale(1.025); width: auto; }
  .alt-message, .alt-welcome, .alt-loading { animation: alt-arrive .68s cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1) both; }
  .alt-desktop-icons { animation: alt-desktop-reveal .65s ease-out both; }
  #alt-pixel-cursor { display: none; image-rendering: pixelated; left: 0; pointer-events: none; position: absolute; top: 0; transform: translate(-3%, -3%); width: clamp(15px, 1.6vw, 25px); z-index: 10; }
  .alt-home-desktop:hover #alt-pixel-cursor.is-visible { display: block; }
  #alt-pixel-cursor.is-hand { transform: translate(-8%, -8%); width: clamp(18px, 2vw, 30px); }
  .alt-home-desktop:not(.is-ready) #alt-pixel-cursor { display: none !important; }
  @keyframes alt-arrive { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.84) translateY(7%); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); } }
  @keyframes alt-bounce { 0% { transform: translateY(0); } 45% { transform: translateY(-8%); } 70% { transform: translateY(-3%); } 100% { transform: translateY(0); } }
  @keyframes alt-desktop-reveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.015); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
  @keyframes alt-zoom-into-screen { 0%, 28% { transform: translate(-50%, -32.2%) scale(1); } 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -32.2%) scale(2.42); } }
  @media (max-width: 700px) { .alt-icon { left: 2vw; width: 70px; }.alt-icon img { max-height: 42px; max-width: 49px; }.alt-icon { font-size: 7px; }.alt-taskbar { height: 32px; } }
</style>

<section class="alt-home-desktop" aria-label="Experimental desktop portfolio homepage">
  <p id="alt-home-status" class="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">New message available.</p>

  <div class="alt-computer-intro" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="alt-computer-visual">
      <img src="images/ux-dashboard/computersemi_final.png" alt="">
      <div class="alt-computer-preview"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/new_message.png" alt=""></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="alt-desktop-icons" hidden>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-projects" href="projects.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/blue_folder.png" alt=""><span>Projects</span></a>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-ux" href="ux-design.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/paint_icon.png" alt=""><span>UX &amp; Product Design</span></a>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-writing" href="writingsamplese.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/cd_icon.png" alt=""><span>Writing Samples</span></a>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-presentations" href="presentations.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/blue_folder2.png" alt=""><span>Presentations</span></a>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-resume" href="experience.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/coral_folder.png" alt=""><span>Resume</span></a>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-home" href="index.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/internet_icon.png" alt=""><span>Home</span></a>
    <a class="alt-icon alt-contact" href="contact.html"><img src="images/ux-dashboard/gear_icon.png" alt=""><span>Contact</span></a>
  </div>

  <div class="alt-layer alt-message">
    <img src="images/ux-dashboard/new_message.png" alt="New message: you have one new message">
    <button class="alt-hotspot" type="button" aria-label="Open new message"></button>
  </div>

  <div class="alt-layer alt-welcome" hidden>
    <img src="images/ux-dashboard/clippy_message.png" alt="Welcome to my web portfolio. Click through the computer folders to explore my work.">
    <button class="alt-continue" type="button" aria-label="OK, continue to the desktop"></button>
  </div>

  <div class="alt-layer alt-loading" hidden aria-hidden="true">
    <img src="images/ux-dashboard/loading_page.gif?animated=1" alt="Loading desktop">
  </div>

  <div class="alt-taskbar" aria-hidden="true"><span class="alt-start">Start</span><span class="alt-task-label">Veronica's Portfolio</span></div>
  <img id="alt-pixel-cursor" src="images/ux-dashboard/arrow_cursor.png" data-arrow="images/ux-dashboard/arrow_cursor.png" data-hand="images/ux-dashboard/hand_cursor.png" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
</section>

<script>
  (function () {
    const desktop = document.querySelector('.alt-home-desktop');
    if (!desktop) return;
    const message = desktop.querySelector('.alt-message');
    const welcome = desktop.querySelector('.alt-welcome');
    const loading = desktop.querySelector('.alt-loading');
    const icons = desktop.querySelector('.alt-desktop-icons');
    const computerIntro = desktop.querySelector('.alt-computer-intro');
    const cursor = desktop.querySelector('#alt-pixel-cursor');
    const status = document.querySelector('#alt-home-status');
    function setState(next) {
      message.hidden = next !== 'message';
      welcome.hidden = next !== 'welcome';
      loading.hidden = next !== 'loading';
      loading.setAttribute('aria-hidden', next === 'loading' ? 'false' : 'true');
      icons.hidden = next !== 'desktop';
      status.textContent = next === 'message' ? 'New message available.' : next === 'welcome' ? 'Welcome message open.' : next === 'loading' ? 'Loading desktop.' : 'Desktop files are ready.';
    }

    setState('message');
    desktop.classList.add('is-zooming');
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      computerIntro.hidden = true;
      desktop.classList.add('is-ready');
    }, 3600);
    desktop.querySelector('.alt-hotspot').addEventListener('click', function () { setState('welcome'); });
    desktop.querySelector('.alt-continue').addEventListener('click', function () {
      setState('loading');
      window.setTimeout(function () { setState('desktop'); }, 3400);
    });
    desktop.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
      if (event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
      const bounds = desktop.getBoundingClientRect();
      cursor.style.left = ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width * 100) + '%';
      cursor.style.top = ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height * 100) + '%';
      const isAction = event.target.closest('button, a');
      cursor.src = isAction ? cursor.dataset.hand : cursor.dataset.arrow;
      cursor.classList.toggle('is-hand', Boolean(isAction));
      cursor.classList.add('is-visible');
    });
    desktop.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { cursor.classList.remove('is-visible', 'is-hand'); cursor.src = cursor.dataset.arrow; });
  }());
</script>
```
